description: Queue one run of a poll now, whatever its schedule. It asks every wording, or with share=true the next part of the poll's rotation at its sample_percent, exactly as a scheduled run would. It spends the account's balance, so the request must carry max_cost_usd (estimate_poll's run_now.hold_micro). Follow it with get_live_run, then read get_results once it settles. Refused with 409 if a run is already in progress. (POST /api/v1/polls/{id}/run)

id.description: The poll's id, or its public address (slug).

max_cost_usd.description: The most, in US dollars, you agree this may commit. Required: the call is refused with the amount it needs if this is missing or too low.

share.description: true: ask the next part of the rotation at the poll's sample_percent, as a scheduled run would (estimate_poll's per_run). false: every wording (run_now).

name: run_poll_now
title: Run a poll once now
